findings.title: One-sided and extremely low liability cap for Datavane
findings.deviation: Datavane's liability is capped at ten thousand dollars, while AtliQ's liability for non-solicitation, confidentiality, and indemnification is completely uncapped. The playbook requires a mutual cap of 1x fees.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited exposure for several categories of claims while Datavane's liability is capped at a nominal amount.
findings.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000). NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.
findings.counterPosition: Make the liability cap mutual and set at 1x fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim, with standard carve-outs.

findings.title: Uncapped, one-way indemnification obligations on AtliQ
findings.deviation: AtliQ is required to indemnify Datavane for any and all losses arising out of services, contract non-performance, representations, or customer claims on an uncapped basis. The playbook requires mutual indemnities limited to third-party claims from own negligence.
findings.impact: AtliQ must cover broad liabilities and defense costs for Datavane without reciprocal protection or a cap.
findings.quote: Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account relating to Partner Services or any Joint Deal; or (e) any act or omission of Partner's personnel or subcontractors. Partner's obligations under this Section 11.1 shall not be subject to any limitation or cap.
findings.counterPosition: Restructure the indemnity to be mutual, cover only third-party claims arising from a party's own negligence or contract violation, and make the indemnity subject to the mutual liability cap.

findings.title: Broad 24-month non-compete and client-capture restriction
findings.deviation: The contract restricts AtliQ for 24 months post-termination from providing any competing analytics platform services to any Datavane Account, including AtliQ's own pre-existing clients registered as prospects. This violates AtliQ's playbook which rejects client-capture and restrictive covenants.
findings.impact: AtliQ would be barred from servicing its own clients with other technology platforms for two years post-partnership.
findings.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
findings.counterPosition: Delete Section 5.3 entirely, or limit it to standard mutual non-solicitation of direct employees.

findings.title: One-sided convenience termination and forfeiture of unpaid revenue
findings.deviation: Only Datavane has the right to terminate for convenience (on 15 days' notice), while AtliQ cannot terminate for convenience during the initial 3-year term. In addition, AtliQ forfeits unpaid revenue share if the customer has not paid prior to termination.
findings.impact: AtliQ is locked into a 3-year term while Datavane can exit at will, and AtliQ risks losing earned revenue share.
findings.quote: Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner. Partner acknowledges the investment made by Datavane in enabling Partner and agrees that Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term. no revenue share or referral fee shall be payable in respect of any Joint Deal or referral not fully paid by the relevant Datavane Account before the effective date of termination;
findings.counterPosition: Make the right to terminate for convenience mutual upon 30 or 90 days' notice, and ensure AtliQ is paid all earned revenue share and referral fees regardless of payment timing.

fine.note: No delay penalties are present in the agreement.
Intellectual property provisions protect AtliQ's background IP and only license marketplace submissions.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard three-year post-termination duration.
The agreement does not impose any insurance requirements on AtliQ.
No set-off clauses are included, which aligns with the playbook.
The agreement does not contain any formal acceptance or cure procedures.
